## Summary
Describe the change and why it is useful.

## Verification
- [ ] I have run the relevant .NET tests (or explained why I couldn't).
- [ ] I have run the frontend build if UI code changed (or explained why I couldn't).
- [ ] I have checked that no secrets, private data, external game artwork, unlicensed catalogues or copied rule text are included.
- [ ] I have updated documentation if the behaviour or setup changed.

## Notes
This project is not actively maintained. Pull requests are welcome, but a maintainer review or merge is **not guaranteed**. Forks are encouraged; please keep changes easy to review and focused on the generic sample.
